m05: US daylight saving starts on 14 March. From April the US orders move an hour earlier, to 21:30 Bangkok time.

m12: After this order all $6,000 is invested apart from its whole-share remainder, which stays as cash at Interactive Brokers. Year two is not planned yet.

funding.lateRule: If a month's money lands after its Friday, place that month's orders on the next open day after it lands. A date never moves earlier.
funding.feeNote: A bank's fixed fee per transfer is a larger share of a small monthly amount than of a large one. Sending two or three months together pays it less often; the order dates stay the same.

differenceRules.text: Sent more or less than planned to Interactive Brokers in a month: that month's VWRA order changes by the difference.
Sent more or less than $250 to SwissBorg: bitcoin stays at $125, and ether and solana share what is left in proportion, up to their $85 and $40. Anything above that stays in the wallet.
Cash left over from whole shares, a skipped order, or an order still above its ceiling after four weeks: it joins the next VWRA order.

rules.if: A stock or fund is above its ceiling on its date
rules.then: Check again each Tuesday for four weeks. Still above: that money joins the next VWRA order.

rules.if: A growth stock or the quantum fund fails its thesis check before its order
rules.then: Skip the order and put the money into the next VWRA order. Do the written review in the thesis section.

rules.if: Ether or solana rose more than 30% in the 30 days before 12 January
rules.then: Buy it on 9 February instead. If it has jumped more than 30% again by then, that money buys bitcoin.

rules.if: A month's money lands after its Friday
rules.then: Place that month's orders on the next open day after it lands. A date never moves earlier.

rules.if: A month's money to Interactive Brokers is more or less than planned
rules.then: Only that month's VWRA order changes, by the difference. If VWRA would drop below zero, the other orders wait for next month's money.

rules.if: Anything you own falls 50% below what you paid
rules.then: Write a review against its thesis checks within a week. Sell only if a check has failed.

rules.if: You want to trade something not in this plan
rules.then: Wait 72 hours. If it is trending online or in the news, it goes on a 30-day watchlist first.

rules.if: A market fall or a rally
rules.then: Never a reason to change a date.

never: Never use options, margin, leverage, SwissBorg Earn or staking.
cryptoRule: Crypto never grows past this plan, and none is added after a month in which it rose more than 30%.

prep.text: Interactive Brokers approved: cash account, W-8BEN filed (claiming your country's tax treaty, if it has one), US and London stock permissions, fractional shares on, dividend reinvestment on.
SwissBorg ready: passkey or two-factor on, residence set correctly, funding route tested with $20.
Three to six months of living costs kept in savings, outside this plan.
Practice run at Interactive Brokers: buy $5 of a US stock, then find the fill and the fee in the account's history.
Thesis checks written for the growth stocks, the quantum fund and the coins (on the Rules page).
All twelve order dates and the twelve transfer days (both November transfers go on 2 Nov) in your phone calendar.
On Friday 27 November, write down the closing prices of GE Vernova, Vertiv, argenx, Insmed and QNTM. They set those five ceilings.
prep.appNote: Type them in Settings here, and each ceiling is worked out for you.

milestones.title: Ceiling day
milestones.text: Closing prices of GE Vernova, Vertiv, argenx, Insmed (close + 10%) and QNTM (close + 15%) set their ceilings.

maintenance.detail: Log each account's value. Price alerts stay off.

maintenance.when: Wed 1 Dec 2027, then every 1 June and 1 December
maintenance.detail: Targets as shares of the stock money: index funds 85.2%, growth stocks and the quantum fund 14.8%. Act only on a block more than 5 points off, by pointing the next months' money at the block that is under target. During year one the blocks are off target by design, because growth stocks are bought early and VWRA through to October.
Not planned yet. Write the next twelve months before then: the 27 Nov 2026 ceilings will not fit them.
